_meta.description: Register fragment for the configurable-types-domain-model change (ADR-037). Introduces the TYPE layer: MeetingType, AgendaItemType, PositionType, PositionHold and GovernanceBodyComposition, plus additive `type` references on Meeting, AgendaItem and Decision and the competence fields on DecisionTemplate. See openspec/changes/configurable-types-domain-model/design.md for why an enum was the wrong escape hatch and what is retired as a consequence.

x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

MeetingType.title: Meeting type
MeetingType.description: A configurable KIND of meeting, owned by one GovernanceBody. This is the abstraction whose absence produced the flat, undifferentiated meeting list: Meeting.meetingType was a five-value enum with no relation to the body holding the meeting, so a gremium could not define its own meeting kinds without a developer widening the enum or, when that failed, adding a schema. Mirrors dossiq's caseType: the instance references its type and inherits the type's configuration (allowed agenda-item types, quorum and voting defaults, opening lifecycle state). Created by an administrator at runtime: adding a meeting kind costs zero code (configurable-types-domain-model).

governanceBody.x-notes: The gremium that may hold meetings of this kind. Required — a meeting type belongs to exactly one body, which is what keeps one body's meeting kinds out of another body's picker (REQ-CTM-001 Scenario 2).

initialLifecycle.x-notes: The state a new meeting of this kind opens in. Read declaratively by Meeting's x-openregister-lifecycle initial-from-type binding, so no imperative default is needed (mirrors dossiq caseType.initialStatus).

AgendaItemType.title: Agenda item type
AgendaItemType.description: A configurable KIND of agenda item. This is the schema that lets oral questions, interpellations, incoming documents, council information letters and kascommissie reports stop being five separate schemas with five top-level menu entries: each becomes an AgendaItem carrying one of these types. CRITICAL PROPERTY: owningBody is INDEPENDENT of the body holding the meeting the item sits on. That single decoupling expresses both halves of the kascommissie case with one model: the kascommissie can hold its OWN meeting (a MeetingType whose governanceBody is the kascommissie) AND own an agenda item on the ALV's meeting (this type's owningBody is the kascommissie). No second schema (configurable-types-domain-model).

name.title: Name
name.description: What a user picks when adding an agenda item.
name.x-notes: What a user picks when adding an agenda item. Required.

description.title: Description
description.description: What items of this kind carry and how they are handled.

owningBody.title: Owning body
owningBody.description: The gremium that owns items of this kind. Need not be the body holding the meeting. Empty means the meeting’s own body.
owningBody.x-notes: The gremium that OWNS items of this kind — which need NOT be the body holding the meeting the item appears on. Null means the item is owned by whichever body holds the meeting. This is the field that makes one model express both a body's own meeting and its agenda item on another body's meeting (REQ-CTM-002).

votable.title: Votable
votable.description: Whether an item of this kind can be put to a vote.
votable.x-notes: Whether an item of this kind can be put to a vote. When true, decisionType names what the vote produces.

decisionType.title: Decision type
decisionType.description: The decision type a vote on this kind of item produces.
decisionType.x-notes: The DecisionType a vote on an item of this kind produces. Only meaningful when votable is true.

fields.title: Type-specific fields
fields.description: Additional fields items of this kind carry.

key.title: Key
key.description: The name this field's value is stored under on every agenda item of this kind. Choose it once and leave it alone: renaming it here does not move the values already recorded, so the old ones become unreachable.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the field is called on screen: the caption above the input when someone fills in an agenda item, and the column header where the field is listed.

fieldType.title: Field type
fieldType.description: What kind of answer the field takes, which decides how it is shown and what is accepted: a single line of text, a longer text, a number, a yes/no tick, a date, a pick from the list of choices below, or a link to another record.

required.title: Required
required.description: Tick this to make the field compulsory: an agenda item of this kind cannot be saved while it is left empty.

enumValues.title: Enum values
enumValues.description: The choices someone may pick from, one per entry. Only used when the field type is a pick from a list; leave it empty for every other field type.

fields.x-notes: Additional typed fields items of this kind carry, as a JSON-Schema-shaped fragment. This is where the retired concrete schemas' distinctive properties land (questionNumber, portfolioHolder, steunbetuigingen, …), so no tenant inherits another tenant's vocabulary from a hardcoded schema.

initialLifecycle.title: Initial lifecycle state
initialLifecycle.description: The state an item of this kind opens in.
initialLifecycle.x-notes: State an item of this kind opens in.

lifecycleStates.title: Lifecycle states
lifecycleStates.description: Ordered states an item of this kind moves through.
lifecycleStates.x-notes: Ordered states an item of this kind moves through (e.g. submitted, admitted, scheduled, answered). Configuration, not a compile-time enum.

submissionWindowHours.title: Submission window (hours)
submissionWindowHours.description: How long before the meeting an item may still be submitted.
submissionWindowHours.x-notes: How long before the meeting an item of this kind may still be submitted. Absorbs VragenuurConfiguratie.submissionPeriodHours.

supportThresholdType.title: Support threshold type
supportThresholdType.description: Whether the support threshold is a fraction of the body or an absolute count.
supportThresholdType.x-notes: Whether a support threshold is expressed as a fraction of the body or an absolute count. Absorbs VragenuurConfiguratie.interpellationSupportThresholdType.

order.title: Order
order.description: Display position in the agenda item type picker.
order.x-notes: Display position in the agenda-item-type picker.

isDraft.title: Draft
isDraft.description: A draft type cannot back new agenda items.

PositionType.title: Position type
PositionType.description: A position that EXISTS on a gremium: the gremium's configuration declaring, for example, that a board has a president. Carries a governanceBody back-reference, exactly as dossiq's statusType/resultType/roleType carry a caseType back-reference; a type's configuration lives in child schemas with a back-FK, never inlined as an array on the type, because an inline array cannot be referenced by uuid and PositionHold needs to reference it. Supersedes Post, whose startDate/endDate wrongly described the HOLDER rather than the position, and absorbs TermijnRegeling wholesale (configurable-types-domain-model).

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the position as the organisation calls it.
name.x-notes: Name of the position as the organisation calls it. Required.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the position is responsible for.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: The gremium this position exists on.
governanceBody.x-notes: The gremium this position exists on. Required — a position is part of ITS body's configuration, so a second body has no president unless it declares one (REQ-CTM-005).

key.title: Key
key.description: Stable short name for the position within its body.
key.x-notes: Stable slug for the position within its body, for seeds and integrations.

seats.title: Seats
seats.description: How many people may hold this position at the same time.
seats.x-notes: How many people may hold this position concurrently. A board has ONE president.

order.title: Order
order.description: Display position in the body’s roster.
order.x-notes: Display position in the body's roster.

allowedHoldTypes.title: Allowed hold types
allowedHoldTypes.description: The hold types valid for this position.
allowedHoldTypes.x-notes: The hold types valid FOR THIS POSITION. Deliberately per position, not global: a president may have an interim, a treasurer may not. A PositionHold whose holdType is absent from this list is refused (REQ-CTM-005 Scenario 2).

termDurationMonths.title: Term duration (months)
termDurationMonths.description: Length of one term in this position, in months.
termDurationMonths.x-notes: Length of one term in this position. Absorbed from TermijnRegeling.termDurationMonths, which was a separate object only because there was nowhere on the body to put it.

maxConsecutiveTerms.title: Maximum consecutive terms
maxConsecutiveTerms.description: How many terms one person may serve back to back.
maxConsecutiveTerms.x-notes: How many terms one person may serve back to back. Absorbed from TermijnRegeling.maxConsecutivePeriods.

reappointable.title: Reappointable
reappointable.description: Whether a holder may be reappointed at the end of a term.

votingWeight.title: Voting weight
votingWeight.description: Weight a vote cast by the holder of this position carries.

grantsCompetenceFor.title: Grants competence for
grantsCompetenceFor.description: Decision types this position is competent to decide.
grantsCompetenceFor.x-notes: DecisionType references this position is competent to decide, in addition to the body's own competence. Consulted by DecisionCompetenceGuard.

isRepresentationSeat.title: Representation seat
isRepresentationSeat.description: Whether this position seats a representative delegated by a composing body.
isRepresentationSeat.x-notes: True when this position exists to seat a representative delegated by a composing body — see GovernanceBodyComposition.seatPosition. That is what makes a representation 'itself a position' rather than an anonymous seat.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the position currently exists on the body.

PositionHold.title: Position hold
PositionHold.description: One membership holding one position, for a duration, with a hold type. This is the object decidiq had no way to express: Membership.post was a bare string reference with no duration and no type, so 'X held the presidency, as interim, from A to B' was unsayable and successive holds were inexpressible, although there will always be a next president. It points at a MEMBERSHIP rather than a Person, so you cannot hold a position on a body you do not sit on and the referential integrity is free. Its endDate is INDEPENDENT of Membership.endDate, which is what lets one person be council member until date A but faction leader until date B (configurable-types-domain-model).

membership.title: Membership
membership.x-notes: The membership holding the position. Required. Referencing the membership rather than the Person is what enforces that a holder actually sits on the body (REQ-CTM-006 Scenario 2).

position.title: Position
position.x-notes: The position being held. Required. Constrained to positions on the same GovernanceBody as the membership.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: The body the membership sits on.
governanceBody.x-notes: Denormalised copy of the membership's body, present solely so the position picker can be scoped with x-relation-filter (OpenRegister filters cannot traverse two hops). Never authoritative — the membership is.

holdType.title: Hold type
holdType.description: How the position is held, for example regular or interim.
holdType.x-notes: How the position is held: regular, interim, elect, candidate, acting, or any value the POSITION's allowedHoldTypes admits. Deliberately NOT an enum here — the valid set is defined by the position's configuration, per Ruben's rule that hold types are themselves defined by the position (REQ-CTM-005 Scenario 2).

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: When this hold ends. Empty means open-ended.
endDate.x-notes: When this hold ends. INDEPENDENT of Membership.endDate — a person may be a member until one date and hold a position until another. Null means open-ended. This is one of the two sources the derived retirement schedule unions (REQ-CTM-007, REQ-CTM-008).

termNumber.title: Term number
termNumber.description: Which consecutive term in this position this hold is.
termNumber.x-notes: Which consecutive term in this position this hold is, counted against the position's maxConsecutiveTerms.

reappointable.title: Reappointable
reappointable.description: Whether this holder may be reappointed.
reappointable.x-notes: Whether this holder may be reappointed. Defaults from the position; overridable per hold.

appointedBy.title: Appointed by
appointedBy.description: The decision that made this appointment.
appointedBy.x-notes: The Decision that made this appointment, where one exists.

GovernanceBodyComposition.title: Governance body composition
GovernanceBodyComposition.description: A gremium composed of other gremia. Two kinds, and the distinction matters: 'direct' means the component's members ARE members of the composite (the same people); 'representation' means the component sends a number of representatives, and seatPosition references a PositionType on the composite, so the representation IS ITSELF A POSITION and a delegate's tenure is an ordinary PositionHold with a duration and a hold type, able to be interim like any other office-holder. DISTINCT from GovernanceBody.parentBody, which expresses HIERARCHY ('sits under') rather than composition ('is made of'); a body may have both, and keeping them apart stops parentBody becoming an overloaded field meaning three things depending on bodyType. Supersedes BodyParticipation, which had sharedBody/participant/seats but no seatPosition, so its seats were anonymous (configurable-types-domain-model).

composite.title: Composite body
composite.x-notes: The gremium that IS composed — the Pub quiz. Required.

component.title: Component body
component.description: The gremium it is composed of.
component.x-notes: The gremium it is composed OF — the Management team. Required.

compositionType.title: Composition type
compositionType.description: Whether the component’s members join directly, or send representatives.
compositionType.x-notes: direct = the component's active members resolve as members of the composite (the same people). representation = the component sends `seats` representatives, seated through seatPosition. Required.

seats.title: Seats
seats.description: How many representatives the component sends.
seats.x-notes: How many representatives the component sends. Representation only; ignored for direct.

seatPosition.title: Seat position
seatPosition.description: The position on the composite that a representative occupies.
seatPosition.x-notes: The PositionType on the COMPOSITE that a representative occupies. Representation only. This is what makes the representation itself a position rather than an anonymous seat, so the delegate's tenure is an ordinary PositionHold (REQ-CTM-009 Scenario 2).

votingWeight.title: Voting weight
votingWeight.description: Weight the component’s representation carries in votes.
votingWeight.x-notes: Weight the component's representation carries in the composite's votes.

accessionDate.title: Accession date
accessionDate.description: When the component joined the composite.

exitDate.title: Exit date
exitDate.description: When the component left. Empty means it is still composing.
exitDate.x-notes: When the component left. Null = still composing.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional display label for this composition.

Meeting.description: Patched by configurable-types-domain-model: gains a `type` reference to MeetingType. The existing `meetingType` enum is RETAINED and deprecated for one release so meetings seeded before this change keep rendering; a meeting carrying neither is invalid (Scenario 3).

type.title: Meeting type
type.description: The meeting type this meeting is an instance of.
type.x-notes: The configurable MeetingType this meeting is an instance of. Preferred over the deprecated `meetingType` enum, which stays readable for one release. Inherits the type's agenda-item vocabulary, quorum and voting defaults.

meetingTypeDeprecated.title: Meeting type (deprecated enum)
meetingTypeDeprecated.description: Whether this meeting still relies on the legacy meeting type list.
meetingTypeDeprecated.x-notes: Marker: true when this meeting still relies on the legacy `meetingType` enum because no MeetingType has been backfilled for it yet. Lets the backfill report a COUNT of what remains, which is the difference between a migration that ran and a migration that worked.

AgendaItem.description: Patched by configurable-types-domain-model: gains a `type` reference to AgendaItemType. The existing `itemType` enum (informational/discussion/decision) is retained as a coarse rendering hint; `type` carries the configurable kind. An item's OWNER comes from its type's owningBody and need not be the body holding the meeting.

type.title: Agenda item type
type.description: The agenda item type this item is an instance of.
type.x-notes: The configurable AgendaItemType this item is an instance of.

typeFields.title: Type-specific field values
typeFields.description: Values for the fields declared by this item’s type.
typeFields.x-notes: Values for the fields declared by this item's AgendaItemType.fields. This is where a retired concrete schema's distinctive properties live once collapsed.

Decision.description: Patched by configurable-types-domain-model: gains a `type` REFERENCE to a DecisionType. The reference is resolved at decision time, never copied at creation: which is the whole difference between a template and a type: a template is copied once, a type is consulted at every decision, so changing a type's voting rule governs every subsequent decision of that type.

type.title: Decision type
type.description: The decision type this decision is an instance of.
type.x-notes: The DecisionType this decision is an instance of. Its competentBody decides who may take it, enforced at the write path by DecisionCompetenceGuard rather than merely declared (REQ-CTM-004). The existing `decisionType` enum is retained, deprecated, as a coarse category.

DecisionTemplate.description: Promoted by configurable-types-domain-model from a copy-once TEMPLATE to a live TYPE. It already carried stateMachine, votingRule, quorumRule, voteThreshold and checklist; it lacked the one thing that matters for authorisation: which gremium is competent to take the decision, and nothing referenced it. Both are added here.

competentBody.title: Competent body
competentBody.description: The gremium competent to take decisions of this type.
competentBody.x-notes: The gremium competent to take decisions of this type. Enforced by DecisionCompetenceGuard::assertCompetent() at the WRITE PATH, before persistence — a competence field with no caller is identical to no check at all (OWASP A01:2021, observed on decidesk#60 where three implemented auth methods were never invoked). ABSENCE IS NOT UNIVERSAL COMPETENCE: a type with no competentBody falls back to the governance body of the decision's meeting, and is refused when there is none (REQ-CTM-004).

competentPositionTypes.title: Competent positions
competentPositionTypes.description: Positions additionally competent to take decisions of this type.
competentPositionTypes.x-notes: PositionType references additionally competent to take decisions of this type — for example, only the president may. Consulted by the same guard.
